Plot kNN-DREMI diagnostic

Source: R/dremi.R
plot_knnDREMI.Rd

Creates diagnostic plots for kNN-DREMI like those seen in Fig 5C/D of van Dijk et al. 2018.

Usage

plot_knnDREMI(
  dremi,
  mutual_info,
  x,
  y,
  n_bins,
  n_mesh,
  density,
  bin_density,
  drevi,
  figsize = c(12, 3.5),
  filename = NULL,
  xlabel = "Feature 1",
  ylabel = "Feature 2",
  ...
)

Arguments

dremi

DREMI value

mutual_info

Mutual information value

x

Z-scored X values

y

Z-scored Y values

n_bins

Number of bins

n_mesh

Mesh density

density

Mesh point densities

bin_density

Binned density matrix

drevi

DREVI conditional probability matrix

figsize

Figure size (ignored in R)

filename

File to save plot (optional)

xlabel

X-axis label

ylabel

Y-axis label

...

Additional arguments
